title: Csv.parse Raises ValueError When Running A Bulk Import
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.1.3; operating system Windows 11 24H2;
server region us-west-2.

## Steps

To reproduce:
* With the log window open, start running a bulk import.
* Paste text with a stray character from a spreadsheet.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, running a bulk import should just
complete.

## Actual

It fails on input with characters that nothing validates.
Someone pasted the value from a spreadsheet, stray
characters included, and nothing complained.

## Frequency

It occurs only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:51 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:88 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:53 in run_import
lattice/io/csv.py:45 in parse
ValueError: could not convert string to float: '1.234,56'
